text: Our restoration crew will provide the reef nursery with a complete coral attachment survey by Friday.
I have organized the nursery observations by coral species. You will receive my completed attachment survey before the conservation briefing.
We aim to provide the coral attachment survey by Friday, although rough water may delay the final measurements.
The restoration supervisor said her crew would provide the coral attachment survey on Friday. That was the timetable recorded during yesterday's briefing.
I will give the geometry class a complete set of paper folding proof cards on Wednesday.
The geometry activity uses folded paper to demonstrate angle relationships. I will upload the proof cards and answer sheet before Wednesday's lesson.
I hope to finish the paper folding proof cards before Wednesday, but the diagrams still need checking.
Please prepare a set of paper folding proof cards for the geometry class. Add an answer sheet for the substitute teacher.
Our laboratory team will send the centrifuge rotor balance report to the equipment custodian this afternoon.
The rotor measurements are recorded in grams. I will deliver the signed centrifuge balance report to the equipment custodian by four today.
We anticipate sending the centrifuge rotor balance report this afternoon, subject to a repeat measurement on one carrier.
The laboratory manager said the rotor balance report would arrive this afternoon. Her statement appears in the equipment meeting minutes.
I will bring the finished woodland costume patterns to the theatre wardrobe room tomorrow at ten.
The woodland costumes use detachable felt branches. Our design team will deliver the full pattern set and cutting layouts to wardrobe tomorrow morning.
I am planning to bring the woodland costume patterns tomorrow, but a late fitting could push delivery back.
The woodland costume patterns are already in the wardrobe room. I delivered the pattern set and cutting layouts at ten this morning.
Our audio crew will deliver the edited underwater sound library to the aquarium education team on Tuesday.
The sound library includes shrimp clicks and reef fish calls. I will send the aquarium educators the edited recordings and cue list on Tuesday.
I expect the underwater sound library to be ready Tuesday, although several recordings still need noise reduction.
The sound recordist wrote that she would deliver the underwater library on Tuesday. Her message also mentioned an accompanying cue list.
Our machine shop will deliver the stainless steel valve test fixture to the assembly bench tomorrow.
The valve fixture has replaceable sealing rings. I will bring the finished fixture and its dimensional inspection sheet to the assembly bench tomorrow morning.
The valve test fixture should reach the assembly bench tomorrow unless the stainless steel stock arrives late.
Please bring the stainless steel valve test fixture to the assembly bench tomorrow. Include its dimensional inspection sheet with the hardware.
I will supply the planetarium presenter with the finished lunar eclipse narration script by Wednesday noon.
The narration follows the Moon through Earth's shadow. Our writing team will deliver the final eclipse script and pronunciation notes to the presenter on Wednesday.
I might finish the lunar eclipse narration by Wednesday if the animation team settles the sequence length today.
I will not supply a new lunar eclipse narration script this week. The planetarium presenter is using the previously approved recording.
Our mineral processing team will deliver the completed conveyor belt wear atlas to the plant engineer on Friday.
The wear atlas pairs belt photographs with measured abrasion depths. I will provide the plant engineer with the completed atlas and location index on Friday.
The inspection contractor stated that her team would deliver the conveyor belt wear atlas on Friday.
We are not delivering a conveyor belt wear atlas this Friday. The document mentioned in the plant minutes was a proposed example for training.
Our pest monitoring team will provide the grain store manager with the completed moth trap count chart tomorrow.
The chart separates moth counts by aisle and trap height. I will deliver the grain store's completed trap count chart and location sketch tomorrow morning.
We expect to provide the grain store's moth trap chart tomorrow if all collection envelopes reach the counting room.
The monitoring supervisor promised to provide the grain store's moth trap chart tomorrow. I am passing on her promise from the inspection meeting.
I will deliver the leatherback turtle exhibit's finished sculpted egg replicas to the nature center on Tuesday.
The turtle egg replicas have a flexible textured surface. Our exhibit workshop will supply the nature center with the complete replica set on Tuesday afternoon.
We may deliver the sculpted turtle egg replicas Tuesday if the flexible casting material cures without surface defects.
Please deliver the finished turtle egg replicas to the nature center on Tuesday. Pack each replica in its own padded compartment.
